rows.grounds: numeral forming first member of compound with patra
second member of compound describing the cakra
adjective qualifying cakraṃ, indicating presence of a central pericarp

items.question: What are the defining name and structural features of the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified as royal.
The sixth cakra has eight petals.
The sixth cakra possesses a central pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is characterized as a royal, eight-petaled wheel with a pericarp.
uncertainties: Whether rājānam functions as a proper name or a descriptive epithet is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is the royal one, having eight petals and a pericarp.
